expected_result: PDF should be processed and individual observation records created for review
actual_result: 30-page PDF processed in approximately 31 seconds and 302 observation rows generated for review

test_name: Automated Numeric and Coded Field Extraction
expected_result: Clearly written numeric and coded fields should be automatically extracted and uncertain values identified for review
actual_result: Many structured fields were extracted successfully; recognised species codes included 0254 0133 0634 0702 0043 and 0705, while uncertain values required reviewer verification

expected_result: Handwritten fields that cannot be reliably automated should be presented with the relevant scan crop for manual entry
actual_result: Handwritten observer, area name, species text, nearest street and comment fields were presented with scan crops and could be manually entered by the reviewer

expected_result: Ditto marks should reuse the appropriate previous value and remain available for reviewer verification
actual_result: EcoTrace displayed ditto references to previous rows and carried forward repeated values such as dates and area names for review

expected_result: Uncertain machine readings should be visibly flagged rather than silently accepted
actual_result: Low-confidence fields were displayed with confidence percentages and warnings for reviewer verification

expected_result: Recognised Council species codes should produce corresponding standardised species suggestions
actual_result: Recognised codes produced corresponding species suggestions including 0254 Rainbow Lorikeet, 0133 Masked Lapwing, 0634 Noisy Miner, 0702 Grey Butcherbird, 0043 Crested Pigeon and 0705 Australian Magpie

expected_result: Potential duplicate records should be flagged for human review rather than automatically removed or accepted
actual_result: EcoTrace displayed a Possible duplicate warning for records sharing observer, date, species, area and number and required reviewer confirmation

expected_result: Records should remain awaiting review until verified and approved by a human reviewer
actual_result: Rows 1-10 were manually reviewed against the source scan and the exported records were recorded as Approved (human verified)

expected_result: Incorrect or uncertain machine-generated values should be editable before approval
actual_result: Incorrect or uncertain extracted values could be corrected using the source scan before approval; the exported output recorded fields corrected by the reviewer
